# UNDERWRITING MEMORANDUM — Harley-Davidson, Inc. (HOG)

**Prepared by:** Senior Underwriting Board | **Desk run:** 1 of 5 complete (no refusals) | **T0:** $26.555 (live quote, 2026-10-05)

---

## SECTION 0 — OVERVIEW

| Item | Value | Tag |
|---|---|---|
| Ticker / Company | HOG / Harley-Davidson, Inc. (NYSE) | [Actual] |
| Price T0 | $26.555 (2026-10-05); market cap ≈ $2.76B | [Actual] |
| **Verdict** | **UNDERVALUED — Accumulate** (value basis, buy now on confirmed trend) | |
| Base IV | **$39.57** (+49.0% vs T0; MoS 32.9%) | [Estimate] |
| Bull IV | **$48.05** (+80.9%) | [Estimate] |
| Bear IV | **$25.14** (−5.3%) | [Estimate] |
| Expected IV (0.5/0.3/0.2) | $39.23 → +47.7% expected return; payoff skew 15.2x; quarter-Kelly 24.75% | [Estimate] |

The price is paying for a company whose cash flows *shrink* for a decade (neutral reverse DCF: −8.8% 10-yr CAGR), while the company's own dated targets point the other way. The cash floor alone ($1.896B ≈ $18.2/share) means even my Bear is only 5% below T0, and my Base sits 49% above it.

---

## SECTION 1 — MACRO (DATA 1.5 / 1.6)

- **Rates:** rf 10y 5.24%, real 2.88%, breakeven 2.36%; curve +0.45% steepening; IG spread 1.49%, HY OAS 3.10%. Regime: goldilocks headline (0.341) but contested (margin 0.070); recession 0.081, tightening 0.176. CPI 3.35% / PCE 3.42% — sticky inflation with markets pricing possible further hikes [DATA 1.6, 2026-10-04].
- **Exposure:** (i) Motorcycles are financed purchases — HDFS originations still +10% in Q2'26 despite the capital-light shift [PRIMARY P1], but higher-for-longer rates suppress marginal demand; (ii) HOG is now **BB+ junk** (S&P, 2026-07-09 [Unconfirmed — third-party brief; consistent with filed margin record]) so the HY spread and any further tightening flow directly into parent/HDFS funding costs — this is why my Bear carries +150 bps on COE; (iii) active `oil_shock` (onset 2026-09-28, Hormuz disruption) hits fuel-sensitive recreational consumers and input costs; (iv) the EU trade war is live: USTR Greer said at G20 Milwaukee (2026-10-02) HOG has not sought relief [usatoday via pack news]; the "$2,200/bike" figure circulating in coverage is **resurfaced June-2018 reporting** (BBC/ABC/Business Standard all carry 2018 dates — verified by search), so current EMEA tariff cost is [Unconfirmed]. The observable impact is real and filed: EMEA retail −9% YoY in Q2'26 [PRIMARY P1], with management citing "tariff recoveries" on the Q2 call [Benzinga transcript, 2026-07-23].

---

## SECTION 2 — BUSINESS & MOAT

**Economic engines (mandate 1):**
- **a) Transactional deliveries — HDMC motorcycles.** FY2025 revenue $3.578B [PRIMARY P3]; Q2'26 motorcycle revenue $848M +9% on 39,209 shipments (+9%) [PRIMARY P1]. Volume-driven, cyclical, tariff-exposed in EMEA; the "Back to Bricks" entry-level push trades some mix for volume (Q2'26 gross margin 27.5%, −1.1 pt YoY [PRIMARY P1]).
- **b) Captive installed base — parts, apparel, licensing, dealer network.** Q2'26: Parts & Accessories $177M (−5%), Apparel & Licensing $62M (+2%) [PRIMARY P1]. A genuine recurring stream off a large installed base, but the filings do **not** quantify CSAs/fleet size, so I credit it only inside the base flow, not as a separate multi-year annuity. HDFS (the financing annuity) is being deliberately dismantled: Q2'26 revenue $117M (−55%), operating margin 18.5% [PRIMARY P1] — a shrinking, capital-light stream; FY2025 HDFS operating income was $490M on an $8.3B asset book that is now $4.0B [PRIMARY P1/P3].
- **c) Strategic optionality.** LiveWire EV: loss narrowing (Q2'26 op loss $17.9M vs $18.7M; H1'26 358 units) — an earnings tailwind as it shrinks, not a growth engine [PRIMARY P1]. Product cycle (Sprint/entry models, RIDE relaunch [Unconfirmed — secondary brief]), European production-shift option, and continued buybacks (net share issuance −8.3% 1-yr [DATA 7]).

**Owner earnings after SBC:** TTM owner earnings base **$0.152B** (desk default, ttm_filed; SBC already expensed in net income — counted once, `deducted_in_cf`). Note DATA 3 prints $0.242B by its own arithmetic; the desk default is ~$90M lower, consistent with stripping HOG's large non-operating investment/other income (H1'26: investment income $20.5M + other income $24.5M [PRIMARY P1]). I value on the desk default and flag the gap in SECTION 10. Cash basis is negative (−$0.165B) only because HDFS deleveraging drained working capital (H1'26 OCF −$60M, finance receivables +$297M [PRIMARY P1]) — an accrual base is the representative one.

**Moat (7 factors, 0–3 each → 13/21 → 3.1/5.0, direction: stable-to-improving):** Brand 3 (iconic; "strong MSRP realization" per Q2 call [Benzinga]); loyalty/switching 2; network effects 1 (community/dealer culture, weak formal); cost advantage 1 (no structural edge vs Japanese rivals — the $150M cost program is catching up, not leading); scale 2 (premium heavyweight leader, shrinking base); entry barriers 2 (brand capital + exclusive dealer network); installed-base recurring 2 (real parts stream, unquantified).

**Financial strength:** Net cash $1.896B at 2026-06-30 (cash $1,895.8M vs total debt ≈ $1.5B incl. current portion [PRIMARY P1]) after repaying $811M of MTNs and buying back $100M in H1'26 [PRIMARY P1]. Junk rating (BB+) is the blemish; liquidity is not at risk.

---

## SECTION 3 — VALUATION

**Inputs passed to the desk (all departures from DEFAULTS with reasons):**

| Input | Value | Departure? | Reason / evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Frame / rate | Equity, COE 10.04% | No | Flows are after-interest; COE ANCHOR used as-is |
| base_cf | $0.152B (TTM owner earnings) | No | Desk default; SBC deducted in CF |
| Base growth y1–y5 | +8%, +25%, +12%, +8%, +5% | **Yes** | y1–2 follow the raised FY26 guide and 2027 targets; y3–5 exceed next-FY consensus revenue growth (+3.9%) — desk accepted my `guidance_deviation_reason` ("kept": Base): Q2'26 call (2026-07-23) — "confident in achieving $150 million in fixed cost savings and a $350 million HDMC EBITDA target by 2027" [Benzinga transcript]; PRIMARY P1: "raising FY 2026 guidance for retail sales and wholesale shipments as well as HDMC & HDFS operating income" |
| Fade | 5 yrs to terminal | No | Default structure |
| terminal_g | 2.36% | No | Own revenue trend (−0.81%/yr FY18–25) held at breakeven inflation — appropriate for a structurally flat-to-declining volume franchise |
| terminal_ronic | 10.04% (= COE anchor) | No | r_tc 6.31% < COE, p=0 (no year above cost of equity in 8-yr record) — desk default; growth from y6 is paid for at the cost of equity, conservative |
| Excess cash | **$1.896B** (not $3.092B) | **Yes** | FY25 year-end cash was reduced to $1,895.8M by 2026-06-30 per the company's own balance sheet/cash-flow statement [PRIMARY P1] (MTN repayments, buybacks, HDFS receivables build); the base flow already reflects post-deleveraging run-rate |
| Shares | 104.07M | No | Desk default; consistent with H1'26 basic weighted average of 107.5M and falling [PRIMARY P1] |
| Life | Perpetual | — | Brand/dealer-network franchise, no depleting stock or expiring right; maintenance capex $153.7M FY25 already deducted [PRIMARY P3] |

**Desk terminal (Base):** Gordon @ 2.36% on funded earnings at 10.04% ronic → **implied terminal EV/FCF 13.3x** (Bear 11.2x); terminal value = 43% of Base value. Cross-check: sector trailing-P/E median 16.9x, cluster peers 18.6x [DATA 8.5] — a 13.3x funded-FCF terminal for a cyclical consumer franchise with a junk-rated balance sheet is mid-band, not generous.

**Neutral reverse DCF (mandatory):** at the neutral structure (anchor COE, 10-yr fade) T0 implies **−8.8% 10-year CAGR** — *below the p50* of the $1–10B base-rate distribution (median +5.6%, p90 +16.7%). The market is pricing a decade of cash-flow contraction, not a turnaround. My Base years 3–5 average **+8.3%/yr** vs the price-implied **−28.8%/yr** on that window — a ~37-point gap.

**Crux (the stated disagreement with the price):**
1. **growth_years_3_5 — VALID (desk-verified, reachable):** my +8.3%/yr vs price-implied −28.8%/yr. Evidence: PRIMARY P1 (2026-07-23) guidance raise; Q2'26 call targets of $350M HDMC EBITDA by 2027 and $150M fixed-cost savings [Benzinga transcript, fetched]; HDMC adj. EBITDA margin already at 10.4% vs 9.3% a year ago [PRIMARY P1]. The price says this company's cash flows halve within two years; the filings say margins are expanding into a raised volume guide.
2. *year2_level — submitted but rejected by the desk* (no bull2/bear2 bound printed in the pack, so no reachable price-implied value). It is not counted; the valid crux above carries the verdict.

All other judgment inputs (coe, fade_years, terminal_g, terminal_ronic) are **not reachable** — i.e., even at their bounds the Base exceeds T0; the disagreement with the price lives entirely in the growth path, which is exactly where the dated company evidence sits.

---

## SECTION 4 — SCENARIOS (last complete desk run)

| | Bear (p=0.20) | **Base (p=0.50)** | Bull (p=0.30) |
|---|---|---|---|
| IV/share | **$25.14** (−5.3%) | **$39.57** (+49.0%) | **$48.05** (+80.9%) |
| EV / equity | $0.72B / $2.62B | $2.22B / $4.12B | $3.11B / $5.00B |
| CF path y1–y5 | −15%, −30%, −10%, 0%, +2% | +8%, +25%, +12%, +8%, +5% | +15%, +35%, +25%, +15%, +10% |
| COE | 11.54% (+150 bps junk shock) | 10.04% | 10.04% |
| Terminal EV/FCF | 11.2x | 13.3x | 13.3x |

- **Bear — "tariff + mix trap":** EMEA tariff burden persists unrelieved (USTR, 2026-10-02) and the production shift fails to protect margin; Back-to-Bricks entry mix keeps gross margin at or below 27%; a tightening regime (17.6% probability) plus sticky rates chokes financed demand; HDFS stays capital-light so the old financing annuity never returns; LiveWire losses persist; S&P's margin skepticism is right and junk status raises funding costs (+150 bps). Causal path: volume shock on transactional deliveries → operating deleverage on ~$1.1B HDMC fixed cost base → CF −30% by year 2. **Floor:** no multi-year contracted backlog exists in the filings (wholesale dealer model), so there is no contractual floor to cite — but $18.2/share of net cash [PRIMARY P1] plus a parts base worth ~$0.7B EV keeps the Bear at $25.14, only 5% below T0.
- **Base — "guided turnaround":** raised 133.5k–138.5k unit guide achieved; $150M cost savings land in 2027 (HDMC EBITDA → ~$350M); LiveWire loss steps down toward breakeven by 2028; HDFS stable at ~18% margin on the smaller book; EMEA roughly flat with tariff recoveries. Owner CF $164M → $261M over y1–y5 [desk path].
- **Bull — "full cycle + annuity":** 2027 EBITDA beats $350M; dealer inventory discipline sustains MSRP realization; entry models expand the installed base so parts/accessories compound off a larger fleet; EU tariff resolved or production shift succeeds; buybacks continue (share count already −8.3% in one year [DATA 7] — my static 104.07M count makes the Bull conservative on dilution).
